generation: Generate numeric public static final double constants from parameters. Owned sources are SpriteExtrusionGeometry, SpriteExtrusionRenderer and pure SpriteExtrusionGeometryTest.

geometry.algorithm: Alpha grid up to64cells along longest dimension, aspect preserved. Cell occupancy uses coverage of source alpha>=threshold. Greedy nonoverlapping rectangles cover occupied top/bottom cells; exposed cell edges alone get vertical sides, including inner holes. Side UV samples come from an opaque source pixel near the occupied cell center.
geometry.coordinates: Normalized local x,z footprint[-0.5,0.5], y[-0.5,0.5]; nose is -Z. Native sprite width/depth is region.width/height*region.scl()/Vars.tilesize. Extrusion depth is clamped minimum native side times DEPTH_FRACTION.
geometry.uv: Top/bottom retain original region UV and shader alpha cutoff; side faces use opaque representative pixels. Atlas UVs inset half texel. No asset copying or atlas modification.
geometry.limits: Pure generator halves resolution down to configured minimum if face count exceeds vertex cap; fails visibly to native renderer if it still cannot fit. Coverage approximation can simplify holes/features below a grid cell.
geometry.attitude: yaw is original Mindustry degrees0east/+90north, pitchpositiveclimb, rollpositivebankright; extrusion center passed from native unit altitude bridge.

runtime.ownership: Read only Core.atlas.getPixmap(AtlasRegion), never dispose or mutate host Pixmap/Texture. Unsupported rotated/flipped/missing/oversized regions returnfalse for existing renderer fallback.
runtime.cache: Bounded identity LRU by native body region, with UV/dimension/texture validation; positive and negative entries share count cap. Byte budget includes both GPU VBO and Arc CPU vertex backing estimate. At mostone new build eachframe; fallback handles deferredtypes. Own temporary alpha copy exists only during missbuild and is not distributed.
runtime.renderState: Optional begin()/end() batches save and restore program, texture0 binding/activeunit, depthtest/writes, blend/cull. Standalone render wraps itself. Mesh/shader cleanup on failures, eviction and dispose; no VBO per ordinaryframe.
runtime.team: On the body-local top cap only, preserve native UnitType.drawCell for non-Crawlc units with drawCell=true. Sample the original cellRegion from the same atlas texture, centered using native physical body/cell dimensions (region dimensions times scl), and alpha-blend its RGB multiplied by the native UnitType.cellColor(unit), including health-dependent color. The body alpha discard runs first, so cell art cannot fill silhouette holes. Missing, flipped, rotated or different-texture required cell art returnsfalse to the original caller fallback rather than silently losing team identity. No second texture unit or generated team art is used.
runtime.simulation: No modification of unit state, collision, health, AI, selection, height or world.

acceptance: Opaque rectangle becomes one top and one bottom rectangle, side edgesonly.
Ring silhouette preserves hole and interior side faces.
Disconnected regions remain disconnected; transparent silhouette emits no geometry.
Top/bottom UVs cover actual normalized footprint; normals/winding are outward.
Alpha threshold/coverage and reducedresolution/vertex limits behave deterministically.
Yaw/pitch/roll transform axes agree with altitude adapter; test basis withoutArc/GL.
Cache bytes/count bounded, native assets never disposed, deferred builds usefallback.
Native cell overlay remains centered at its own physical dimensions, appears only on body-local top, follows cellColor(unit), and never fills transparent body holes.
limitations: Grid approximates the outline at bounded resolution; not a handcrafted unit model.
Main unit body and its native top cell overlay only; animated legs, weapons and crawler segment cells are not reconstructed by this module.
Unsupported atlas regions retain the previous renderer rather than malformed extrusion.
